# Minimal GA-CPS Host Files

This directory vendors the minimal GA-CPS-style base-framework code required by
the SHTA 3D training scripts.

Included files:

- `GALoss.py`
- `dataloaders/dataset.py`
- `networks/vnet.py`
- `utils/test_util_vnet_AB.py`
- `utils/test_amos_vnet_AB.py`
- `utils/cube_utils.py`

This folder intentionally does not include datasets, checkpoints, logs, or
historical experiment scripts.
